info.name: Jyotiva REST API
info.description:
HTTP API collection for the Jyotiva backend.
Set baseUrl if needed, start the backend, then run Authentication > Send OTP and Verify OTP.
The collection saves development OTPs and auth tokens automatically when returned.
Admin requests require the matching admin role.
Delete, financial, publish, and status-changing requests can modify local data; check descriptions before sending.
Realtime chat events use Socket.IO and are not ordinary HTTP requests in this collection.

request.description: Local development may return devOtp. The test script saves it in this collection.

Requires VAPID configuration and a real browser push subscription.
